heading: INT. SLEEPING CAR, NIGHT TRAIN - NIGHT

units.text: INT. SLEEPING CAR, NIGHT TRAIN - NIGHT
Brass lamps swing with the rails.
Rain beads the window.
On the table between the seats, a chess set mid-game and an untouched bottle of wine.
BARNABAS HOLT (50s, silver beard) leans back with his hands folded.
Opposite him sits LEOPOLD VANCE (50s, silver moustache), staring at the board.
At the door, the conductor, ISADORA FEYERABEND (30s, brass buttons), has just finished punching tickets.
Your move.
units.name: BARNABAS

units.text: I know.
units.name: LEOPOLD

units.text: Gentlemen, we reach Vienna at dawn.
units.name: ISADORA

units.text: Plenty of time to lose.
units.name: LEOPOLD

units.text: Time for you to lose.
units.name: BARNABAS

units.text: You've both been playing since Prague.
units.name: ISADORA

units.text: He cheats.
units.name: LEOPOLD

units.text: He sulks.
units.name: BARNABAS

units.text: One of you left this on the floor.
units.name: ISADORA

units.text: She holds up a small brass key.
Barnabas reaches for it.
Leopold reaches too.
They both stop, hands in the air.
He looks at the key.
He looks at the other man.
He knows.
That opens the trunk in the baggage car.
units.name: LEOPOLD

units.text: Does it?
units.name: BARNABAS

units.text: It does. And the trunk is empty.
units.name: ISADORA

units.text: She closes the door behind her.
The train rattles on through the dark.
